pairs.difference: Both cards are purple on yellow. In B, the fan's leaves are one pure magenta-violet with no rest color. The flat colors show only two violet masses, and the handle is a flat salmon (subject chroma 0.226, above the real maximum of 0.189). In A, the white eyelet lace gives the umbrella a neutral band, the canopy has a lighter violet side and a darker one, and the cane is a believable brown.
pairs.fix: Make the fan's paper a softer, dusty violet with lighter faded areas. Give it a pale cream or white edge trim and natural brown wooden ribs.

pairs.difference: In A, an orange suitcase sits on a yellow sunburst, so the hero and backdrop share the same warm color. The lime-green floor and five fully saturated stickers add more loud hues. In B, a red-brown trunk sits against a cool blue sky and grey stone paving. That is a warm hero on a cool, partly neutral backdrop, which is how the real cards work.
pairs.fix: Put the orange suitcase on a cool sky-blue sunburst background. Make the floor a muted grey-blue, and tone the stickers down to softer colors.

pairs.difference: In A, a red target rim sits in front of a red booth wall, with orange wood framing, an orange teddy bear and an orange shelf. The hero repeats the backdrop's hue and almost the whole card is red-orange (warm share 0.716, above the real range). In B, a cream envelope with colorful photos sits on a green swirl. That gives a clear hero against the backdrop and a neutral cream mass.
pairs.fix: Put the target on a cool blue or teal back wall instead of red. Make the booth frame a plain mid-brown, and let the teddy be the only orange.

pairs.difference: In B, the blue sneakers carry candy-colored accents: lime collars, teal laces, a hot-pink trim and orange tabs. That makes about 5.5 hue families, above the real range. The cream-and-orange floor and wall join the warm mass. In A, the hatbox uses navy, red and cream on green. That is a small palette, and the cream stripes give the eye a neutral place to rest.
pairs.fix: Give the sneakers a single accent color. Make the laces white, the soles white or light grey, and remove the pink and orange trim.

pairs.difference: Everything in A is warm (warm share 1.0, with 1.86 hue families, below the real range). The piano is red-brown, the wallpaper cream-peach, the floor orange and the pedals gold, and the shadows all go to deeper red-orange. There is no cool backdrop to set the hero apart. In B, the red guitar sits on a blue and violet stage under yellow and cyan spotlights. That is a warm hero on a cool backdrop.
pairs.fix: Put the red-brown piano against a cool pale blue or sage-green wall. Make the floorboards a neutral grey-brown, and let the shadows fall cool and dark instead of orange.

pairs.difference: In A, a white cake stand sits on a lavender cloth in front of purple stripes. The cast shadow under the stand turns strong purple (shadow chroma 1.61, above the real range). The pastel pink and mint cakes are the only other hues, so the hero's chroma (0.053) is below the real cards. In B, a beige fountain with cyan water sits on a yellow backdrop, with warm and cool clearly separated.
pairs.fix: Make the tablecloth a plain white or light grey with soft grey shadows. Raise the color of the cakes slightly so the hero holds its own against the purple wall.

pairs.difference: In A, the cup is pure cobalt with a gold rim on hot pink. Both masses are at full chroma (subject 0.183, above the real range), and only the steam gives any rest. In B, a blue vending machine sits on violet, with pale cyan glass and a silver tray that add neutral relief. B is cool on cool, but A's all-loud palette is further from the real cards.
pairs.fix: Make the teacup a slightly deeper, less electric blue with white or pale highlights. Soften the background to a dusty, muted pink.

pairs.difference: In A, a gold watch on a green harlequin pattern makes the hero and backdrop neighboring yellow-green hues (1.52 hue families, below the real range). In the flat colors, the gold reads as olive-green, and the dial numbers pick up green. In B, a red ring box sits on a cyan burst with a beige interior and a gold coin. That is a warm hero on a cool backdrop, with a neutral mass to rest the eye.
pairs.fix: Put the gold pocket watch on a cool blue or violet background so the gold separates. Make the dial numbers dark navy.

pairs.difference: In B, the navy cap sits on a cyan backdrop, so the hero repeats the backdrop's blue family. Only the orange band and tassel break the cool mass. In A, the black hat with a red band reads as believable local color, although its shadows go dead black (shadow chroma 0.46, low). This is a weak call, because the measurements flag A while my eye flags B.
pairs.fix: Make the graduation cap a deep charcoal-black instead of royal navy, so it does not share the blue of the background.

pairs.difference: In B, the scarf is one flat, pure red from light to shadow (subject chroma 0.217, above the real range). The flat colors show two red masses with no change of hue, and the badge is also orange-red. In A, the red fan has gold ribs and a crimson bead, so the hero has a second, lighter material. Both cards are loud, and B is louder and more uniform.
pairs.fix: Make the scarf a slightly deeper red that turns toward crimson-burgundy in its folds. Give the badge a pale gold or cream face.

pairs.difference: In B, a cream feather sits on yellow-orange stripes over an orange wooden table (warm share 0.896, above the real range). The white of the feather has gone cream, as in the lesson cards, and only the dark green bottle is cool. In A, an orange wooden chair sits on blue stripes with a lime cushion. That is a warm hero on a cool backdrop, like most real cards.
pairs.fix: Make the feather a clean, cool white with grey-blue shadows. Put it on a cool blue or teal striped wall, and keep the table a mid-brown.

pairs.difference: In A, the red bus sits among cream-yellow clouds, pink and green buildings, a blue sky and a purple-grey road. That is 6.3 hue families, at the top of the real range. Its shadows go flat grey-violet (shadow chroma 0.556, below the real range), and the clouds have the same cream cast seen in the generated lesson cards. In B, a neon cyan ice cream sits on a teal wall, with pink and orange as accents.
pairs.fix: Paint the clouds pure white with soft blue-grey shading. Make the background buildings one muted color, and let the bus's shadows stay a rich dark red.

pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away by warmth and by repeating hues. Whole cards drift warm: whites turn cream, floors and walls go orange, and the backdrop shares the hero's hue family instead of sitting against it. Heroes are painted in one pure, flat hue with no neutral area to rest the eye. Shadows either go flat grey or turn the same color as the backdrop (purple, red-orange) instead of staying a rich, related color.
